E1.evidence:
Issue kobuki_desktop#10 'rqt_plot failed due to kobuki_qtestsuite?' (yhju, 2013-04-02) contains the reproducer and error log: `$ rosrun rqt_plot rqt_plot` ends in "  File "/opt/ros/groovy/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/qt_gui/plugin_menu.py", line 130, in _enrich_action
    raise UserWarning('icon "%s" not found' % str(path))
UserWarning: icon "../src/kobuki_qtestsuite/resources/images/kobuki_icon.png" not found". 130s confirmed ("I confirmed that this happens when `kobuki*` are installed") and opened qt_gui_core#16 'No package path getting set in python plugins', where the maintainers diagnosed it: DorianScholz, 2013-04-07: "This problem is due to the combination of new qt_gui_core packages with "old" rqt packages.
I committed changes to both repos, but only the qt_gui_core was tagged and released, the latest tag on the rqt repo is 3 month old...". The packet's fix commits (rqt 9682b9a, qt_gui_core ffae1f7, both 2013-05-28, both citing qt_gui_core#16) are the definitive fix.

E2.evidence: Step 1: the units whose interaction failed are qt_gui (package in ros-visualization/qt_gui_core; the host framework whose PluginManager.discover() calls the plugin provider and hands each PluginDescriptor to PluginMenu.add_plugin(), which reads a base-path attribute from the descriptor to resolve file icons) and rqt_gui (package in ros-visualization/rqt; its RosPluginProvider subclasses qt_gui's PluginProvider and builds the PluginDescriptor attribute dictionaries for ROS plugins). They are separately released packages from different repositories (qt_gui_core 0.2.14 was released while rqt stayed at 0.2.8). The Kobuki plugin whose icon triggered the exception (kobuki_qtestsuite, package in yujinrobot/kobuki_desktop) only supplied the input that exposed the mismatch; see notes. Step 2: not internal: at qt_gui 0.2.14 PluginMenu reads `base_path = plugin_descriptor.attributes().get('package_path')` (changed from 'plugin_path' by 295a040) while rqt_gui 0.2.8 sets `'plugin_path': plugin_path` and no 'package_path', so base_path is None and the relative icon path is used unresolved; the failure depends entirely on which attribute key each side uses. Step 3: no deployment name binding is involved. Step 4: not build-only; the attribute key of the descriptor contract (a library-API data contract between PluginProvider implementations and qt_gui) was renamed on the provider side. Step 5: not firmware. Step 6: eligible; interface kind library API. The dataset summary frames the case as the rqt tool versus the Kobuki plugin's path semantics; the primary sources (qt_gui_core#16 body, DorianScholz's diagnosis, the 295a040 and 0.2.8 code) locate the failed interaction between qt_gui and rqt_gui, and that is followed here.

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: the provider (qt_gui) ran at a newer revision than the consumer (rqt_gui) was written against. qt_gui_core 0.2.13/0.2.14 (tagged 2013-03-28, containing 295a040 of 2013-03-25) reached the Groovy debs while rqt remained at 0.2.8 (2013-01-11), whose provider code still supplies the descriptor key as qt_gui read it before 295a040. DorianScholz: "only the qt_gui_core was tagged and released, the latest tag on the rqt repo is 3 month old". The reverse combination (rqt at 1a4c407 setting 'package_path' with qt_gui_core at 4efcbd4 reading 'plugin_path' after the revert), reported by 130s on 2013-04-07 from source, shows the same symptom but is not the reporter's composition; it is recorded in notes.

E4.evidence: Observed failure: rqt_plot (and rqt, in 130s's source reproduction) aborts at plugin discovery with the traceback ending "UserWarning: icon \"../src/kobuki_qtestsuite/resources/images/kobuki_icon.png\" not found".

failed_conditions.quote:
plugins_menu.py made a change:

```
-        base_path = plugin_descriptor.attributes().get('plugin_path')
+        base_path = plugin_descriptor.attributes().get('package_path')
```

But python plugin descriptors are not setting their package path.

loudness_evidence: The host framework's own plugin-discovery check raised at rqt start-up, aborting the tool: "  File \"/opt/ros/groovy/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/qt_gui/plugin_menu.py\", line 130, in _enrich_action\n    raise UserWarning('icon \"%s\" not found' % str(path))\nUserWarning: icon \"../src/kobuki_qtestsuite/resources/images/kobuki_icon.png\" not found" (https://github.com/yujinrobot/kobuki_desktop/issues/10). The diagnostic names the symptom (an unresolved relative icon path, i.e. no base path was prepended) rather than the descriptor-key mismatch itself; it occurs during plugin discovery when rqt is activated, before any plugin is loaded.

resolution.summary: Definitive fix (the packet's commits): qt_gui_core ffae1f7 and rqt 9682b9a make both sides use the descriptor key 'plugin_path', defined as the directory of the plugin XML file. rqt_gui's RosPluginProvider now sets `'plugin_path': os.path.dirname(plugin_xml)` instead of `'package_path': package_path` and loads modules from `attributes['plugin_path']`; qt_gui's PluginMenu keeps reading 'plugin_path', qt_gui_cpp's provider is changed to set 'plugin_path' too, the help provider is fixed, and rqt_gui/package.xml declares `<run_depend version_gte="0.2.16">qt_gui</run_depend>` so the two packages are installed together. Interim fix that restored the reporter's deb installation: qt_gui_core 0.2.15 (2013-04-02) reverted 295a040 and c686e6a (commits ae478da, ebbac32), returning PluginMenu to 'plugin_path'.
resolution.evidence: stonier, 2013-06-03, on qt_gui_core#16: "Just dropped down the latest source for qt_gui_core and rqt and recompiled kobuki_qtestsuite against them with relative icons.\n\nAll seems ok :+1:!" (https://github.com/ros-visualization/qt_gui_core/issues/16#issuecomment-18817746). The groovy-devel heads of both repositories on that date were exactly ffae1f7 (qt_gui_core, 2013-05-28; next commit 2013-06-04) and 9682b9a (rqt, 2013-05-28; next commit 2013-06-05), so both units of the resolved composition are identified. dirk-thomas then released them ("I have just released all these changes to the farm (Groovy and Hydro).", 2013-06-07; qt_gui_core 0.2.16 and rqt 0.2.9 tagged 2013-06-06). The interim revert was also observed working by the reporter with the debs: yhju, 2013-04-05: "I'm using public debs for testing and verifying. It resolved now."

notes: Mechanism from the code: PluginManager.discover() (qt_gui) calls `self._plugin_provider.discover()` and then `self._plugin_menu.add_plugin(plugin_descriptor)`; PluginMenu.add_plugin at 0.2.14 reads `base_path = plugin_descriptor.attributes().get('package_path')` and _enrich_action does `path = action_attributes['icon']; if base_path is not None: path = os.path.join(base_path, path); icon = QIcon(path); if len(icon.availableSizes()) == 0: raise UserWarning('icon "%s" not found' % str(path))`; rqt_gui 0.2.8's RosPluginProvider._parse_plugin_xml sets `attributes = {'plugin_name': plugin_name, 'plugin_path': plugin_path, 'library_path': library_path}` with `plugin_path = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(xml_file_name))`. The raw relative path in the diagnostic confirms base_path was None. consumer_built_against.broken = 0.2.10 is inferred: rqt 0.2.8 was tagged 2013-01-11T15:08:49-08:00, four seconds after qt_gui_core 0.2.10 (2013-01-11T15:08:45-08:00), and at 0.2.10 through 0.2.12 PluginMenu reads 'plugin_path', which rqt_gui 0.2.8 supplies; 0.2.13 (2013-03-28) is the first tag containing 295a040. consumer_built_against.resolved is additionally documented on the consumer side: 9682b9a's message cites ros-visualization/qt_gui_core#16 and adds `version_gte="0.2.16"` on qt_gui (0.2.16 is the tag that contains ffae1f7). Third unit: kobuki_qtestsuite, kobuki_desktop tag 0.1.5 (d07fd69d4803f01f31a22fa685f85142c35545ab, 2013-02-16, the Groovy release installed as /opt/ros/groovy/stacks/kobuki_desktop/kobuki_qtestsuite), whose plugins/testsuite_plugin.xml declares `<library path="../src">` and `<icon type="file">../src/kobuki_qtestsuite/resources/images/kobuki_icon.png</icon>`, paths relative to the plugins/ subdirectory; the icon file exists at kobuki_qtestsuite/src/kobuki_qtestsuite/resources/images/kobuki_icon.png. Only this plugin was affected because, as DorianScholz noted, "many of the other rqt plugins don't break because they're using `<icon type="theme">` not `<icon type="file">`" and "kobuki_qtestsuite has it's plugin.xml in a subdir and the library and icon path in it are set to be relative to this subdir." Other compositions documented in the thread, not part of this case: (a) qt_gui versus kobuki_qtestsuite over the base of relative paths in plugin.xml (the wiki said package-relative, the code was plugin.xml-relative; dirk-thomas settled on plugin.xml-relative: "I have pushed the changes that resources are resolved relative to the plugin.xml file, which was the intended behavior"); kobuki_qtestsuite's XML did not need to change and its icon path stayed `../src/...` through 0.1.6 (4b5517f) and the catkinisation 732e45a; (b) the reverse revision pairing seen by 130s from source on 2013-04-07 (rqt 1a4c407fc118b95f3e9077f4838898b78bc4fa0c, which sets 'package_path', with qt_gui_core 4efcbd4b00865df02e159ceefbf8b87d9ed3fb4f, which after the reverts reads 'plugin_path'), the same key mismatch in the opposite direction; (c) the qt_gui_cpp provider change in ffae1f7 for C++ plugins. Confidence is medium because the broken provider tag (0.2.13 versus 0.2.14, identical in the relevant code) and the reporter's environment are inferred from the traceback and release dates, and because the composition choice follows the maintainers' diagnosis rather than the dataset's summary.
